biotools.summary: A bioinformatics resource providing resources and methodology for characterizing the genomic and functional diversity of the marine bacterial genus *Pseudoalteromonas*. It utilizes whole-genome sequencing and phylogenomic inference to study bacterial diversification in bivalve microbiomes.
